    Studies and tools using clustermole

    Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics studies across several species and tissues have used clustermole for cell type annotation.

    Human

    • Zhang X, Jia L, Yeziya T, et al.
      Integrated Mendelian randomization and single-cell RNA sequencing analyses reveal lactate metabolism as a key pathway in COVID-19-induced pulmonary fibrosis.
      Canadian Respiratory Journal. 2026.
      doi:10.1155/carj/1049336

    • Wang T, Zhang L, Mei S, et al.
      Single-cell RNA sequencing highlights the unique tumor microenvironment of small cell neuroendocrine cervical carcinoma.
      Journal of Translational Medicine. 2025.
      doi:10.1186/s12967-024-05977-z

    • Zhang X, Deng X, Zhang L, et al.
      Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of lung cells in COVID-19 patients with diabetes, hypertension, and comorbid diabetes-hypertension.
      Frontiers in Endocrinology. 2023.
      doi:10.3389/fendo.2023.1258646

    • Chen L, Jin S, Yang M, et al.
      Integrated single cell and bulk RNA-seq analysis revealed immunomodulatory effects of ulinastatin in sepsis: a multicenter cohort study.
      Frontiers in Immunology. 2022.
      doi:10.3389/fimmu.2022.882774

    • Hong Y, Chen L, Sun J, et al.
      Single-cell transcriptome profiling reveals heterogeneous neutrophils with prognostic values in sepsis.
      iScience. 2022.
      doi:10.1016/j.isci.2022.105301

    • Zhang L, Tang C, Zhang M, et al.
      Single cell meta-analysis of EndMT and EMT state in COVID-19.
      Frontiers in Immunology. 2022.
      doi:10.3389/fimmu.2022.976512

    • Han X, Shen J, Yan J, et al.

    • Zheng X, Dozmorov MG, Espinoza L, et al.
      Inducible deletion of Ezh2 in CD4+ T cells inhibits kidney T cell infiltration and prevents interstitial nephritis in MRL/lpr lupus-prone mice.
